name: browser-pilot-native-commands
transport: Browser Pilot Bridge WebSocket command envelope

content.fingerprint.notes: Internal page fingerprint signal used by execute/observe effect collection.

operation.begin.notes: Internal operation supervisor arm command. Observers are installed before the mutating action is dispatched.

operation.checkpoint.notes: Internal source fence. Pending MutationObserver records are drained before the checkpoint event is emitted.

intercept.install.notes: optional stages/requestStages may restrict Fetch.enable patterns to request and/or response interception for bounded fixtures

intercept.continue.notes: patch may mutate url, method, headers, postData/body before send; body strings are UTF-8 base64-encoded for CDP Fetch.continueRequest.postData

layer.probe.notes: Internal LayerTree mechanism probe for owner backendNodeId evidence; not an agent-facing workflow command.

ALREADY_INSTALLED.summary: Requested recorder or hook session is already installed.

AMBIGUOUS_DOWNLOAD.summary: Download click produced multiple possible download events without a precise match.

AMBIGUOUS_TAB_ID.summary: Multiple connected browsers expose the same numeric tabId.

TAB_LEASE_CONFLICT.summary: Target tab is leased by another browser session.

UI_LOCK_CONFLICT.summary: Browser UI is locked by another browser session.

BACKGROUND_THROTTLED.summary: Background tab throttling affected page-side timing.

BODY_UNAVAILABLE.summary: Captured network body is unavailable or expired.

BACKEND_NODE_STALE.summary: Referenced backend node could not be resolved in the current tab target.

BRIDGE_CLIENT_DISCONNECTED.summary: Extension client disconnected before a pending command completed.

BRIDGE_SEND_FAILED.summary: Bridge failed to send a command to the extension client.

BRIDGE_START_FAILED.summary: Bridge HTTP/WebSocket server failed to start.

BRIDGE_STOPPED.summary: Bridge stopped while a command was pending.

BRIDGE_TIMEOUT.summary: Bridge command timed out before a response arrived.

BROWSER_COMMAND_FAILED.summary: Browser command returned a structured failure result.

BROWSER_EXECUTION_ERROR.summary: Browser execution or page-script evaluation failed.

BROWSER_EXTENSION_RECONNECT_TIMEOUT.summary: Extension reload did not reconnect before the deadline.

BROWSER_NOT_FOUND.summary: Requested browser client was not found.

QUEUE_FULL.summary: Browser command queue reached its configured depth limit.

CANCELLED.summary: Wait, network wait, or subscription was cancelled.

CONTENT_EXTRACTION_FAILED.summary: browser_observe content extraction did not return structured content data.

CROSS_ORIGIN_IFRAME.summary: Requested operation cannot cross an iframe origin boundary.

ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND.summary: Page-side selector did not match an element.

EVENT_SUBSCRIPTION_FAILED.summary: Page event listener subscription or cleanup failed.

FRAME_DETACHED.summary: Target frame detached before command completion.

INJECTION_FAILED.summary: Hook dispatcher injection or readiness check failed.

INTERNAL_ERROR.summary: Unexpected internal runtime or tool failure.

INVALID_REF_TARGET.summary: Referenced input target lacks a backendNodeId and explicit point fallback.

MATURE_BRIDGE_LAUNCHER_NOT_FOUND.summary: External mature bridge launcher was not found.

MATURE_BRIDGE_LAUNCHER_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED.summary: Explicit mature bridge launcher overrides require an opt-in flag.

MATURE_BRIDGE_LAUNCHER_PROBE_TIMEOUT.summary: External mature bridge launcher probe timed out.

MATURE_BRIDGE_LAUNCHER_PROBE_FAILED.summary: External mature bridge launcher probe failed.

MATURE_BRIDGE_LAUNCH_FAILED.summary: External mature bridge process failed to start.

MATURE_BRIDGE_PROCESS_TIMEOUT.summary: External mature bridge process timed out.

MATURE_BRIDGE_TARGET_REQUIRED.summary: External mature bridge requires an explicit scoped target or request input.

MATURE_BRIDGE_TEMPLATE_SELECTION_REQUIRE.summary: External mature bridge requires explicit template or selector input.

INVALID_BROWSER_COMMAND.summary: Command payload failed native protocol validation.

INVALID_BROWSER_ID.summary: Browser id is malformed or unsupported.

INVALID_RULE.summary: Tool rule or mode combination is invalid.

INVALID_SESSION.summary: Requested session id does not match the installed session.

INVALID_TAB_URL.summary: browser_tabs create URL is invalid or blocked.

NAVIGATION_TIMEOUT.summary: Navigation wait timed out or failed before target state.

PRIVATE_TARGET_BLOCKED.summary: Private, link-local, or metadata targets require explicit opt-in.

NETWORK_RECORDER_NOT_STARTED.summary: Network recorder session is not started.

NOT_INSTALLED.summary: Page hook dispatcher is not installed.

NO_BROWSER_EXTENSION.summary: No browser extension client is connected.

NO_SESSION.summary: No matching runtime session or tab-scoped dispatcher is available.

OOPIF_SESSION_UNSUPPORTED.summary: Referenced backend node belongs to a target/session that could not be attached or resolved safely.

TARGET_ATTACH_FAILED.summary: Persistent CDP could not attach or recover a child target session.

NO_TAB.summary: No usable target tab is available for a tab-scoped command.

REQUEST_NOT_FOUND.summary: Network request id was not found in recorder state.

SAFETY_BLOCKED.summary: Browser blocked file access or another safety-sensitive operation.

SELECTOR_NOT_FOUND.summary: Selector was valid but did not match an element.

REF_SCOPE_VIOLATION.summary: ABML ref scope does not match the current session, tab, or origin.

HANDLE_KIND_MISMATCH.summary: Referenced handle kind does not match the expected kind.

HANDLE_ETAG_MISMATCH.summary: Referenced handle etag does not match the current artifact.

PRIVACY_BLOCKED.summary: Requested access is blocked by ABML privacy policy.

ACTIONABILITY_TIMEOUT.summary: Target did not satisfy actionability predicates before timeout.

TARGET_OCCLUDED.summary: Target is occluded and cannot receive events.

CROSS_ORIGIN_BLOCKED.summary: Requested operation is blocked by cross-origin frame boundaries.

SESSION_NOT_FOUND.summary: Requested runtime session was not found.

TAB_ID_CONFLICT.summary: Conflicting tab id values were supplied.

TAB_NOT_FOUND.summary: Target browser tab is not connected.

TIMEOUT.summary: Generic runtime wait or command timeout.

WAIT_TIMEOUT.summary: Durable browser wait exceeded the total timeout budget.

WAIT_STATE_LOST.summary: Durable browser wait could not survive browser extension state loss or restart.

RUNTIME_STATE_RECOVERED.summary: Configuration/session metadata was restored without evidence loss.

RUNTIME_STATE_RECOVERED_WITH_HISTORY_LOS.summary: Configuration/rules were restored, but volatile runtime evidence was lost.

RUNTIME_STATE_LOST.summary: Runtime state cannot be safely reconstructed; caller must rebuild explicitly.

WEBSOCKET_INVALID_INPUT.summary: WebSocket command input was invalid or incomplete.

WEBSOCKET_SESSION_ALREADY_OPEN.summary: A WebSocket session with the same session id is already open.

WEBSOCKET_SESSION_NOT_FOUND.summary: Requested WebSocket session was not found.

WEBSOCKET_SESSION_NOT_OPEN.summary: Requested WebSocket session exists but is not open.

WEBSOCKET_OPEN_TIMEOUT.summary: WebSocket open timed out before the connection became ready.

WEBSOCKET_INVALID_MATCHER.summary: WebSocket wait matcher was unsafe or invalid.

WEBSOCKET_WAIT_TIMEOUT.summary: WebSocket wait timed out before a matching inbound message arrived.

WEBSOCKET_WAIT_ABORTED.summary: WebSocket wait aborted because the session closed or errored.

UNKNOWN_BROWSER_CLIENT.summary: Requested browser client id is unknown.

UNSUPPORTED_TARGET.summary: Target URL, element, or chooser mode is unsupported.

UPLOAD_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.summary: browser_upload requires confirm:true after user approval.

UPLOAD_FILES_LIMIT.summary: browser_upload file count exceeds the supported limit.

UPLOAD_FILES_REQUIRED.summary: browser_upload requires at least one file.

UPLOAD_FILE_NOT_FOUND.summary: browser_upload file path does not exist.

UPLOAD_PATH_NOT_ABSOLUTE.summary: browser_upload requires absolute local file paths.

UPLOAD_PATH_NOT_FILE.summary: browser_upload path is not a file.

UPLOAD_REQUIRES_BROWSER_UPLOAD.summary: transfer.upload must go through browser_upload validation.

WORDLIST_PATH_BLOCKED.summary: Local wordlist paths must stay within allowed roots and bounded size.

HTTPS_CERT_GENERATION_FAILED.summary: Callback HTTPS certificate generation failed or explicit certificate inputs were invalid.

RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.summary: Referenced browser-result resource was not found.

RESOURCE_STALE.summary: Referenced browser-result resource is stale; re-capture to mint a fresh handle.

RESOURCE_READ_ERROR.summary: Failed to read the referenced browser-result resource.

SCAN_BUNDLE_INVALID.summary: Page-world scan returned a malformed or unknown capture bundle.

EXTENSION_CONTRACT_MISMATCH.summary: The connected extension capture contract is incompatible with this daemon.

browser_network.actionDescription: start | stop | status | clear | list | get | body | exportHar | wait

browser_hook.actionDescription: listTargets | installTargets | install | collect | status | clear | pause | resume | uninstall | evaluate | addEventListener | removeEventListener | performance | listSessions | getNodeListeners | getListenerChain | getSinkHints
